Put the OBS-engine capture helper here (built from ../../native/capture, or downloaded from the
GitHub Actions artifact "isu-capture-win-x64"):

    isu-capture.exe
    libdshowcapture.dll
    LICENSE-libdshowcapture-LGPL-2.1.txt

They are bundled into the packaged app (resources/capture). Binaries are not committed to git.
